scope: Retained desktop artificial native-ABI input runs. Both CPUs at 4. Body progress/gaps preserve the native-frontier helper's complete 180→1200 window. Independent runs share stimulus plans, not exact captured tapes, scheduling, or host load; no causal or statistical A/B inference.

inputScope.boundary: firstWireAtMs is the serialized local input send-intent hook before successful send/delivery, not exact native capture.
inputScope.response: Conditional latest-submitted-movement → first changed wire → next new-frontier renderer submission. No per-event gameplay effect or visible movement is proven; no hardware-input, physical phone, browser compositor completion or photon latency.
inputScope.denominators: All due/submitted/coalesced/unsubmitted/future-censored counts are retained per run. Response distributions cover only conditionally attributed presented events. Submission-to-render is calculated per event, never by adding quantiles.
inputScope.comparison: All-observed input response spans each source's own active lifetime. The capture-frame subset is explicitly conditional and does not supply an all-due body denominator.
